name: corrections
description: Turns a recurring correction into an enforced check. /corrections:codify counts how often a described mistake recurs, picks the strongest enforcement-ladder rung that can catch it, and proposes a check proven to fail on the old code and pass on the current code, using scripts/prove-check.sh to run it in temporary worktrees at two refs.

findings_buffer_adapter_repository.title: Findings-buffer adapter repository
findings_buffer_adapter_repository.description: Git common directory (git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) of the one repository whose own findings-buffer adapter you trust. Applies in that repository's checkout and worktrees only. Unset: only adapters the plugin ships run.

findings_buffer_adapter_path.title: Findings-buffer adapter path
findings_buffer_adapter_path.description: That repository's adapter directory, relative to the checkout root, holding executable append.sh and read.sh and a capabilities.json with schema_version 1.x. Set both options or neither. A path out of the checkout or into a nested repository is refused.
